## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -9.56%) BELOW TREND (fear falling) and SPY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY with Stocks vs Bonds ratio ↑ rising — supporting risk-on despite pick-up in credit stress.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -9.56%) BELOW TREND. Credit stress RISING: HYG (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.22%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +0.09%) CORRECTION — HYG/LQD signal is a contra-risk-on flag.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-looser: UUP (1W: -0.49% | 1M: +2.09%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: -1.74% | 1M: +0.21%) CORRECTION show mixed dollar/yield dynamics while Yield Curve (1W: -1.74%) ↓ falling signals modest flattening.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Healthcare and biotech leadership: XBI (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +25.72%) ABOVE TREND and XLV (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +12.34%) ABOVE TREND; Financials XLF (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +8.46%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%) BELOW TREND — rotation toward cyclicals/value evident.

5. US vs Global?
US showing relative strength: SPY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY while EEM (1W: -3.33% | 1M: -6.72%) BELOW TREND and FXI (1W: +0.73% | 1M: -11.58%) RECOVERY but weak on 1M — Europe vs US is above trend, EM remains laggard.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative risk elevated: ARKK (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +1.68%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +4.03% | 1M: -8.36%) RECOVERY show risk-on positioning; IWM (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +2.27%) CORRECTION signals small-cap participation is mixed.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Mixed commodities: CPER (1W: +0.84% | 1M: -8.15%) RECOVERY while GLD (1W: +2.35% | 1M: -8.21%) RECOVERY and SLV (1W: +5.08% | 1M: -19.08%) RECOVERY reflect metal bounces against weak base/industrial readings.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy remains weak: XLE (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -7.52%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -25.00%) BELOW TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: -1.45% | 1M: +0.96%) CORRECTION offers the only green note in the group.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -9.56%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY support the RISK-ON label. DIVERGENCE: XLK (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%) BELOW TREND vs XLF (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +8.46%) ABOVE TREND is a major divergence that argues for selective exposure and monitoring.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclical/defensive rotation and growth pockets: XLF (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +8.46%) ABOVE TREND, XBI (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +25.72%) ABOVE TREND and XLV (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +12.34%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength; reduce exposure to XLK (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%) BELOW TREND and monitor credit spread signals (HYG/LQD).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XBI (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +25.72%) ABOVE TREND and XLV (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +12.34%) ABOVE TREND if momentum holds. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%) BELOW TREND and XLE (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -7.52%) BELOW TREND on 1M weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: SLV (1W: +5.08% | 1M: -19.08%) RECOVERY and GLD (1W: +2.35% | 1M: -8.21%) RECOVERY on safe-haven flows. BEARISH: BNO (1W: -5.28% | 1M: -25.00%) BELOW TREND and USO (1W: -4.88% | 1M: -24.25%) BELOW TREND on persistent oil weakness.

13. Key Levels?
VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -9.56%) BELOW TREND — watch ~20 for complacency shift. HYG (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.22%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +0.09%) CORRECTION — monitor HYG/LQD around current spread. XLK/XLF (1W: -3.96% | 1M: -16.02%) ↓ falling — watch break below ~3.0 for deeper tech weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive.  
Healthcare/biotech and financials showing strength (XBI, XLV, XLF ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk: major divergence between XLK (1W: -2.16% | 1M: -8.78%) BELOW TREND and XLF (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +8.46%) ABOVE TREND and a pickup in credit stress (HYG/LQD) to monitor.
